metadata.question: Were there more snow in north-central Chile in July, 16 2022 than July 7, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Dataset: MODIS Snow Cover (MOD10A1) is ideal for snow detection - Location: North-central Chile - I'll use a polygon covering the Andes region - Dates: July 7, 2022 and July 16, 2022 - Band: 'NDSI_Snow_Cover' for snow detection 2. Masking strategy: - MOD10A1 has quality flags, but for simplicity I'll mask values > 100 (invalid data) - The question is specifically about snow, so I need to focus on valid snow pixels 3. Logic: - Compare total snow area between the two dates - Need to check for empty collections first - Check if valid pixels exist after masking - Validate the snow area values are reasonable Let me define a polygon for north-central Chile covering the Andes region where snow would be expected. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-71.0, -30.0], [-68.0, -30.0], [-68.0, -33.0], [-71.0, -33.0], [-71.0, -30.0] ]]); const date1 = '2022-07-07'; const date2 = '2022-07-16'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Snow Cover const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(geometry); const img1 = modis.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')).first(); const img2 = modis.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')).first(); // Check for empty collections const img1Exists = img1 && ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(img1, null).not().getInfo(); const img2Exists = img2 && ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(img2, null).not().getInfo(); if (!img1Exists || !img2Exists) { console.log(`July 7 image exists: ${img1Exists}, July 16 image exists: ${img2Exists}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Process snow data - NDSI_Snow_Cover band (0-100 snow cover percentage) // Mask invalid values (>100) const snow1 = img1.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').updateMask(img1.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').lte(100)); const snow2 = img2.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').updateMask(img2.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').lte(100)); // Calculate snow area (sum of snow cover percentages) const snowArea1 = snow1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const snowArea2 = snow2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data const count1 = snow1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const count2 = snow2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const area1Val = snowArea1.getInfo(); const area2Val = snowArea2.getInfo(); const count1Val = count1.getInfo(); const count2Val = count2.getInfo(); console.log(`July 7: Area=${area1Val?.toFixed(0)}, Pixels=${count1Val}`); console.log(`July 16: Area=${area2Val?.toFixed(0)}, Pixels=${count2Val}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count1Val === 0 || count2Val === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (area1Val === null || area2Val === null || isNaN(area1Val) || isNaN(area2Val) || area1Val < 0 || area2Val < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare snow areas if (area2Val > area1Val) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
